headline: Zota Health Care LImited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - ZOTA: Zota Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of 39,228 equity shares of M/s Davaindia Health Mart Limited, Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company, by way of subscription to the right issue.
